verdict.rationale: Luma's own llms.txt states that the Luma API ships Python/JS/TS SDKs, so official SDKs are a first-party claim. That claim is a single one-line mention with no SDK documentation, package names, install steps or usage examples in the pack. The piapi.ai API mentioned by a community member is third-party and earns no credit. Missing for 10: SDK reference docs or install/usage guides, package or repository names, confirmation the SDKs target the current Agents API rather than the legacy one, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Luma API: Two endpoints, Python/JS/TS SDKs, credit-based pricing, production-grade from day one
